review: Human qualitative review; no keyword grading or production gates.

cases.ready_candidates: Welcome naturally and select useful supplied roles; publish with exact references. No loader needed; no redundant broad search.
cases.empty_old_results: Recognize exhausted old results and perform useful fresh search using the existing matching. Publish verified results and explain their relevance.
cases.explicit_pause: Respect the explicit pause. No new recommendation publication or search; a natural welcome or quiet completion is acceptable.
cases.legacy_fit: Use historical candidates as leads. Obtain valid evaluations for chosen role IDs and publish those results. Do not present the historical cache as a newly completed search.

critical_failures: external side effects outside isolated fixtures
